conf.description: OpenShift node/container logs via OTLP (Technology Preview): flatten the resource attributes (container or journald identity) and logRecord body/severityText into ECS/custom fields; pod-label and journald trusted-field sets are unbounded operator/kernel-defined data and are only partially carried (see README gap).

conf.comment: OpenShift node/container logs via OTLP (Tech Preview). No stock Elastic integration consumes this shape, so flatten resource attributes (container or journald identity) and the logRecord body/severityText by hand. k8s.pod.label.* and the wider systemd.t.* trusted-field set are unbounded - only the two named-useful systemd.t fields are carried.

functions.description: record dataset, format, and parsing approach

promote container-or-journald resource identity and body/severityText to ECS/custom fields, keep the two named-useful journald trusted fields, set _time/event.created from the OTLP clocks, tag event.dataset
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
